title: v1.0.134 released (AU1)
body: Faster start: the app no longer reads the multi-MB offline copies (orders, desk, usage) on the main thread before the first screen; they load a moment later. Fewer big writes: offline copies at most every 90 s; the 8.6 MB bets file is saved 2 s after the last change and when you leave the app, and read as a stream. Newer star evidence (11-16) shipped. Engine rules unchanged: no evidence to loosen them (bids fill: 177 of 357). NOT found: why the app closes on first open after an update (no crash record on Android 10); the next diagnostics launch trace will tell.
